skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Ritual of Immortality
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection/Ritual of Immortality. Clothes Ho'olheyak wore while touring the ruins. Under a loose coat lies an exceedingly-modern black dress, making clear that her purpose here is not to explore the past, but to sneer at its passing.
skins.quote: Atop the pedestal engraved with the past, her lithe steps make a mockery of history.

skins.name: Carriage of the Winds of Time
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Carriage of the Winds of Time. Ho'olheyak's concert outfit, evoking a classical yet romantic dance. She chose the fabrics with utmost care, wrinkled for her key performance, and gilded for the years everlasting.
skins.quote: The night wind blows away an ancient melody, and the stars leave behind an instant of mirth. In the end, all things must fade. But spare them no thought for now. Ho'olheyak steps down from the stage, reciting eternity at you.
